assessment_summary: I validated the installation in the same container by (1) confirming the environment (Node 22.20.0/npm 10.9.3, repo @seitenbau-dev/formulardesigner v1.0.2 at /workspace), (2) verifying each step of the installation summary: root `npm install` (node_modules present), `npm run build` artifacts in /workspace/dist (ES bundle, CSS, .d.ts, correct `FormularDesigner` export), example install with the `file:..` symlink resolving to the built package, and the Vite dev server process still active with a ready log, (3) querying the local interface: HTTP 200 at http://localhost:5173 serving the example app shell, and (4) behavioral validation in headless Chromium: the React app mounts and renders the complete designer UI (palette, canvas, toolbar) with no console or page errors; the guide-documented model-download path (ref.getModel → JSON) produces a valid form JSON. My initial probe that palette clicks alone didn't change the model turned out to be an interaction-model misunderstanding (the intended flow is field-group dialog + drag-and-drop, per the repo's tests), which I resolved by running the repository's own Playwright suite (93 tests, 18 files) against the running server with its reuseExistingServer setting: all 93 passed with exit code 0, covering drag-and-drop module insertion, dialog configuration, validation rules, fixture loading, and JSON download comparison. The one Vite log line about a dep-optimizer file is a benign 404 from a deliberately probed path during the install, not an app or build error, and does not affect behavior. Limitations: validation used headless Chromium rather than a full desktop browser, and the dev server is bound to localhost only (no --host), consistent with the guide. No files were modified during validation; temporary validation scripts were removed (evidence screenshots/JSON kept in /tmp). Conclusion: the installation matches the guide, is complete, and the software demonstrably operates.
